    Ultrapower microstate extraction — reducing the CEP backward direction to one sub-axiom #

    This file reduced connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace (the entire backward direction of the Connes/Kirchberg equivalences, previously a monolithic axiom) to a single precisely-stated sub-axiom tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction, together with a fully kernel-trio proof of the ultrafilter finite-concentration step. tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction was itself discharged to a proved theorem (commit 556ef4a2f) using the concrete tracial-ultraproduct model in ConcreteUltrapower.lean — no axiom remains in this file.

    Mathematical content #

    Given a trace-preserving *-algebra embedding ι : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] U.Rω into a tracial matrix ultrapower, we need to exhibit, for every finite F ⊆ A and ε > 0, a matrix microstate.

    What this file proves (kernel-trio, no sorry): The finite ultrafilter concentration lemma: given sequences (one per element of a finite set F) that each converge to a limit along a fixed ultrafilter ω, there exists a single index k where ALL convergence conditions hold simultaneously within tolerance ε. This uses only the ultrafilter's finite intersection property and nonemptiness.

    What was extracted as a named external input, now discharged (tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction, proved below): Given an abstract TracePreservingUltrapowerEmbedding τ U, extract the standard Connes/Kirchberg/Voiculescu finite-dimensional microstate data:

    • a VARIABLE matrix dimension dim : ℕ → ℕ
    • the ultrafilter ω used by the germ model
    • fiber tracial states σ k on MatrixAlg (dim k)
    • sequences seq a k : MatrixAlg (dim k) for each a : A that are EXACTLY star-preserving and unital pointwise, only L2-ASYMPTOTICALLY multiplicative (trace L2Seminorm error → 0 along ω), with σ k (seq a k) → τ a along ω. (A fixed dimension and exact pointwise multiplicativity would be mathematically WRONG for a general Connes embedding.)

    This step requires a proper bounded metric/tracial ultraproduct (bounded matrix sequences modulo the 2-norm-null ideal, with trace ultralimit) — NOT raw Filter.Germ, which lacks C*-structure and is the wrong carrier. See OPP-CEP-FILTER-GERM-SEQ-EXTRACTION for the discharge target.

    Registry target #

    C-KIRCHBERG-GAME-SEP-NEG-CEP (ALG+EXT, tier S) drops all external axioms in its backward direction:

    • BEFORE: axiom connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace (whole backward direction)
    • INTERMEDIATE: axiom tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction (sequence extraction only)
    • AFTER (commit 556ef4a2f): tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction proved (kernel-trio); zero axioms remain besides the externally cited kirchberg_game_separation.

    The ultrafilter concentration argument — formerly implicit inside the monolithic axiom — is now explicitly kernel-trio proved in this file.

    The named external axiom: sequence-level extraction from the abstract ultrapower #

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (U : TracialMatrixUltrapower) (emb : TracePreservingUltrapowerEmbedding τ U) :
    ∃ (dim : ℕ → ℕ) (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (σ : (k : ℕ) → TracialState (MatrixAlg (dim k))) (seq : A → (k : ℕ) → MatrixAlg (dim k)), (∀ (a : A) (k : ℕ), seq (star a) k = star (seq a k)) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ), seq 1 k = 1) ∧ (∀ (a b : A), Filter.Tendsto (fun (k : ℕ) => L2Seminorm (σ k) (seq (a * b) k - seq a k * seq b k)) (↑ω) (nhds 0)) ∧ ∀ (a : A), Filter.Tendsto (fun (k : ℕ) => (σ k).toPositiveLinearMap (seq a k)) (↑ω) (nhds (τ.toPositiveLinearMap a))

    Microstate sequence extraction (formerly an axiom, now proved from the concrete tracial-ultraproduct model): a trace-preserving embedding into a tracial matrix ultrapower yields matrix-sequence microstates with exact pointwise star/unit, L2-asymptotic multiplicativity, and trace convergence.

    Kernel-trio: finite ultrafilter concentration lemma #

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.ultrafilter_concentration_finite {ι : Type u_1} (F : Finset ι) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f : ι → ℕ → ℂ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hconv : ∀ a ∈ F, Filter.Tendsto (f a) (↑ω) (nhds (c a))) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ), ∀ a ∈ F, dist (f a k) (c a) < ε

    Finite ultrafilter concentration (existential form, kernel-trio).

    For a genuine ultrafilter ω and sequences converging along ω, find a concrete index k at which all convergence conditions hold simultaneously.

    The main theorem: connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace as a proved theorem #

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace_from_seqExtraction {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (h : ConnesEmbeddable τ) :
    IsAmenableTrace τ

    Connes embeddability implies matrix microstate approximability.

    This is now a PROVED THEOREM (not an axiom), given the named external input tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction.

    Proof structure:

    1. From tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction, extract dim, ω, σ, seq with exact pointwise star/unit, L2-asymptotic multiplicativity, and convergent trace along ω.
    2. For given F, ε: apply finset_concentration_eventually twice — once to the trace conditions (σ k (seq a k) → τ a, a ∈ F) and once to the pairwise L2-multiplication errors (L2Seminorm (σ k)(seq (a*b) k − seq a k · seq b k) → 0, (a,b) ∈ F×F) — then intersect (.and + Filter.nonempty_of_mem) to get one index k where ALL hold within ε.
    3. The microstate at k: dim k, σ k, φ a := seq a k.
      • map_one: from hone k (exact)
      • map_star: from hstar a k (exact, restricted to F)
      • map_mul_l2: from the L2-concentration at k (the multiplicative error is < ε, NOT zero).
      • trace_close: from the trace-concentration at k, ‖τ a − σ k (seq a k)‖ < ε.
